'''Kaiseroo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Kangachamp]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "When trapped in a corner with allies needing protection, panic gave way to total determination. Rather than swinging wildly with eyes closed, Kaiseroo locked onto targets with a focused gaze and unleashed a pulverizing punch that could smash through anything."

Kaiseroo is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A large kangaroo that wears sunglasses, gold earrings, and red boxing gloves with yellow stars on them. Its body is orange-brown with a cream-white underside. It also has curly dark brown hair, a pipe in its mouth, and wears a boxing belt. Draped behind it is a gray-blue cape with red clasps and a gold chain.

Kaiseroo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with blue. The yellow stars on its boxing gloves also become light blue.

== Trivia ==
* Kaiseroo was added to the game on 7/29/2026 alongside [[Budboo]] and [[Saberheart]].
